correctness.rationale: Finite exhaustive mathematical proof for C=L(Q3): all 4096 subsets tested by the exact induced-degree predicate; all 456 faces and 1524 Hasse incidences reconstructed. The explicit 12-pivot matching has 212 disjoint pairs, 32 critical dimension-three faces and no cyclic gradient path (complete oriented Hasse topological sort). By reduced discrete Morse theory this is integrally a wedge of thirty-two S3. All 48 affine cube symmetries preserve the graph; the eight triangles reconstruct Q3, proving this is full Aut(C). The reduced Lefschetz signed fixed-face formula, applied to all 48 automorphisms, gives the ten character rows, fixed dimension two and antipodal eigen-dimensions 21/11. Independently checked mod-two boundary ranks (11,55,109,36) corroborate but do not prove the integral conclusion. Executed the exact package checker successfully.

value.rationale: The graph is the canonical cuboctahedral (rectified cube) line graph and the complex is the natural first higher-independence analogue of cube-edge matching selection, not an arbitrary parameter slice. Its complete integral homotopy classification is nontrivial (nonpure four-dimensional complex yet a wedge of 32 three-spheres). The full ten-class octahedral rational character, two-dimensional fixed subspace and 21/11 antipodal splitting are substantial symmetry data absent from the homotopy rank and relevant to equivariant topology. The theorem is precisely a motivated finite classification; no unsupported infinite-family implications are claimed.
